---
title: "Count by Size Category"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

## Data Preparation

```{r}
# Corrected Data
data <- data.frame(
  count = c(87, 30, 12, 3, 4), # numeric counts
  category = c("singleton", "(2-10 genomes) small", "(11 -50 genomes) medium",
               "(51 -100 genomes) big", "(100+ ) huge")
)

# Convert category to ordered factor
data$category <- factor(data$category, 
                        levels = c("singleton", "(2-10 genomes) small", 
                                   "(11 -50 genomes) medium", 
                                   "(51 -100 genomes) big", "(100+ ) huge"), 
                        ordered = TRUE)
```

## Correlation Calculation

```{r}
# Calculate correlation
cor_value <- cor(data$count, as.numeric(data$category), method = "spearman")
cor_value
```

## Visualization

```{r, echo=FALSE}
library(ggplot2)
p <- ggplot(data, aes(x = category, y = count)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "skyblue") +
  geom_text(aes(label = count), vjust = -0.5) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Count by Size Category",
    x = "Size Category",
    y = "Count"
  )

print(p)
